title: Try the neovim plugin with the real viewer inside decade
body: The plugin in editors/nvim and acre-gui --stdio landed in 934e4ef, tested in headless neovim against a stand-in viewer only. A run with the real viewer from neovim inside decade put the viewer's window in another workspace, which decade-1919e9 is to settle. Once that lands, run :AcreView from neovim in a decade pane on figures/key-schemes.acre and check four things: where the window goes, rendering as you type, a click on the render moving neovim's cursor, and an error showing as a diagnostic. Open a window outside scratch_open only after Jack says to.
close_reason: Jack ran every check by hand in decade on 2026-11-24 with the release viewer at 64c7b3b, and all passed: window placement, rendering as he types, :AcreView switching buffers, click to cursor, error diagnostics, a drag with one undo, snapping, double-click text edits with Shift+Enter, arrow-key moves, edits while typing, the tool palette and anchors, Delete with its refusal, copy and paste, and the properties panel. The earlier note lists the first checks.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/0c799e42
notes.text:
On a220913 a run with the real viewer passed, though only part of this issue could be automated. `editors/nvim/tests/viewer.lua` runs `nvim --headless` with the plugin's own `start()`, which starts `target/release/acre-gui --stdio`. The test checks three things:

- A broken buffer gets an error diagnostic at the right line and column.
- Fixing the buffer clears the diagnostic.
- Breaking it again brings the diagnostic back.

`editors/nvim/tests/edit.lua` checks how the plugin handles an `edit` message, against a stand-in viewer.

These still need a person in decade:

- where the viewer's window goes
- rendering as you type: headless neovim never fires `TextChanged`, so the test sent the text through `BufWritePost`
- a click on the render moving neovim's cursor

The test's window opened on the desktop, not in a decade pane. Nobody looked at the render or clicked it.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/0c799e42
notes.text: Jack checked these by hand in decade on 2026-11-24, with the plugin loaded from editors/nvim and the release viewer at 64c7b3b. The viewer window opens where it should, and the render follows as he types. `:AcreView` in a second buffer moves the open viewer to it, `:b#` and `:AcreView` move it back, and `:AcreView` in the shown buffer closes it. Still to check: a click moving the cursor, an error as a diagnostic, a drag editing the buffer with one undo, a double-click text edit, and edits made while typing.
